notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Company Commander, adding {C}{C}.
Company Commander dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Company Commander from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Company Commander enters the battlefield, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
